items.title: Jalen Brunson On Knicks Poor Start: Everything Falls On My Shoulders
items.summary: Jalen Brunson knows the New York Knicks aren't were they want to be. New York opened its title defense 0-3 after losing at home to the Orlando Magic on Sunday. Brunson says it's on him to be the one to lead a turnaround for the Knicks. "Everything falls on my shoulders," Brunson said when asked about the Knicks offense struggling. "I just got to be a better leader when it comes to that, when it comes to our guys are ready to go in the right spots. There's a lot of other little things, but it's organization on my part." Brunson said that saying it's still early in the season is an excuse, but he doesn't want to excuse his team being inconsistent. The Knicks star is also looking to see how his team responds to the adversity they've hit to open the year. "One thing I said throughout the entire training camp, and honestly to this day, is we're going to see who we are within the first couple weeks of the season," Brunson said. "So, we're hitting adversity now. How are we going to respond?"
